edition_angle: Evaluating biological evidence behind anti-aging interventions and distinguishing proven lifestyle/pharmacological strategies from ineffective supplements.

assignments.angle: Yale's meta-analysis of 51 studies demonstrates that while exercise, healthy diets, and specific prescription drugs measurably slow biological aging clocks, commercial anti-aging supplements fail to show meaningful efficacy.
assignments.reason: Provides a comprehensive, evidence-based synthesized review addressing the efficacy of human longevity interventions, directly counteracting marketing hype around anti-aging supplements.
